<template>
  <el-dialog title="启动容器" v-model="dialogVisible" width="600px">
    <el-form :model="container" label-width="80px" class="container-form">
      <el-form-item label="容器名称" :rules="[{ required: true, message: '请输入容器名称', trigger: 'blur' }]">
        <el-select v-model="container.name" placeholder="请选择要启动的容器">
          <el-option
              v-for="container in containersRef?.containers || []"
              :key="container.id"
              :label="container.name"
              :value="container.name"
          />
        </el-select>
      </el-form-item>
    </el-form>

    <template #footer>
      <el-button type="primary" @click="submitStart">启 动</el-button>
      <el-button @click="dialogVisible = false">取 消</el-button>
    </template>
    <DockerContainers ref="containersRef" />
  </el-dialog>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, nextTick, defineExpose } from 'vue'
import axios from 'axios'
import { ElMessage } from 'element-plus'
import DockerContainers from "@/components/Container/DockerContainers.vue";

const dialogVisible = ref(false)
const container = ref({ name: '' })

// 引用 DockerContainers 组件
const containersRef = ref(null)

// 打开弹窗时刷新容器列表
const openDialog = async () => {
  container.value.name = ''
  dialogVisible.value = true
  await nextTick()
  containersRef.value?.fetchContainers()
}

// 提交启动请求
const submitStart = async () => {
  if (!container.value.name) {
    ElMessage.warning('请选择要启动的容器')
    return
  }

  try {
    const response = await axios.post(`http://localhost:8081/container/start/${encodeURIComponent(container.value.name)}`)
    dialogVisible.value = false
    ElMessage.success(`启动成功：${response.data}`)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('启动容器出错：', error)
    ElMessage.error('启动失败：' + (error.response?.data || error.message))
  }
}

// 向父组件暴露方法
defineExpose({ openDialog })
</script>

<style scoped>
.container-form {
  padding-top: 10px;
}
</style>
